purpose: Capture the declared three-scenario BullMQ retry/backoff conformance scope in the Software Rules format.

boundary.description: A bounded retry/backoff decision and terminal-state probe; not a complete capture of BullMQ or a full queue implementation.
included: Processor attempt count and attemptsMade values
Custom backoff strategy inputs and results
excluded: Other retry options and unrecoverable-error variants
Queue scheduler, rate limiting, stalled jobs, and worker shutdown
Production deployment and external application behaviour
Exact processor error-message equality between source and replica

scope.description: Three deterministic retry/backoff scenarios: positive delays then completion; -1 suppression; zero-delay retry followed by attempts-limit failure.

collector.name: Instrumented BullMQ worker, QueueEvents, and Job state
collector.methodDescription: Controlled scenario execution with instrumentation of processor calls, backoff strategy arguments/results, queue lifecycle events, and terminal job state.

runtimeRules.subject: job-retry-policy
runtimeRules.proposition: A job is retried after a processor failure only while the configured attempts limit permits another attempt; when the limit is reached, the job transitions to failed.

applicability.scope: The configured attempts=2 boundary in this case.

runtimeRules.subject: job-retry-policy
runtimeRules.proposition: A custom backoff result of -1 suppresses retry, a positive delay routes through delayed state, and zero routes immediately back to waiting.
runtimeRules.trigger: A processor attempt throws and the custom backoff strategy returns a value.

applicability.scope: The tested deterministic custom strategy results -1, 0, 40, and 80 milliseconds.

runtimeRules.subject: job-attempt-counter
runtimeRules.proposition: BullMQ increments attemptsMade after each failed attempt and also after a successful completion; the value observed at the start of processing is the number of prior failures.
runtimeRules.trigger: A processor attempt fails or completes.

applicability.scope: The tested two-failure-then-success, suppressed-retry, and attempt-limit scenarios.
